VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 58 tests pass and describes the fix in detail, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 58 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. Without CI logs, test results, or code review artifacts, there is no way to independently confirm the fix is correct or that the tests actually pass.
